# Geelooy Total Revelation — Mission and Evidence

## Mission

Transform the public `geelooy` surface into a coherent, mobile-first, futuristic, accessible, fast, retractable interface system without introducing global CSS conflicts or changing unverified contracts.

The Awtsmoos is beyond every interface and every file; the many pages are vessels, not islands. On Awtsmoos.com, each route may carry its own garment while the underlying intention remains one. Let the borders stay clear, the motion stay light, and every screen reveal delight.

## Observed evidence

- Repository root: `/Users/awtsmoos/work/awtsmoos.com`.
- Root `AGENTS.md` requires inspection before claims, full-file rewrites, small modules, and real verification.
- `geelooy` contains dozens of product areas and at least roughly eighty discoverable `index.html` entry points before archive/test fixtures are excluded.
- Home already has a modern hero, launcher, omnibox, featured cards, and a mobile dock.
- Docs and Drive already use many local stylesheet modules.
- Apps mixes route-local CSS with broader `/style/geelooy-app/` and `/style/future-system/` layers.
- Social Hub mixes broader shell CSS with local CSS and contains dense single-line markup that is difficult to maintain.
- `geelooy/index.css` contains unscoped universal selectors, which conflicts with the new no-global-style requirement if consumed by pages.
- `geelooy/oyvedEdom.js` is a legacy service-worker implementation with mixed formatting, debug logging, and minimal documentation.

## Hard constraints

- No blind global reset.
- Every migrated visual rule must be rooted under an explicit page/surface selector.
- No layout may rely on viewport overflow as a hiding mechanism.
- Z-index values must come from a documented local layer scale.
- Every relevant interactive control needs visible hover, active, focus-visible, disabled, and motion-reduced behavior.
- Touch targets must remain usable on phones.
- Complete-file rewrites only.
- Existing public APIs and route contracts survive unless a deliberate migration is verified end to end.
- No archive, generated, vendor, or test-fixture rewrite merely to make audit numbers look better.

## Evidence still required

- Exact Git working tree state, branch, and commit receipt.
- Usage graph for `geelooy/index.css` and legacy service-worker files.
- Selector-scope audit of shared CSS layers.
- Runtime/browser receipts for each migrated surface.
- Syntax/import/test receipts for touched JavaScript.
